create.name: Istituto Iyengar Yoga Firenze
create.bio:
The Istituto Iyengar Yoga Firenze is a long-established Iyengar school on Via San Gervasio in Florence, founded by Gabriella Giubilaro. She began practising in 1973 under Dona Holleman, gave up a career in physics for yoga, and has studied in Pune with B.K.S. Iyengar and his children Geeta and Prashant since 1981. She still teaches at the institute each week and travels widely to lead seminars across Europe and beyond.

A team of around ten certified teachers shares the timetable, which runs from early-morning sessions to evening classes on most weekdays. Classes cover several levels, with an advanced group, sessions for older students, a pranayama practice and a weekly class for teachers, and some are streamed or taught online in Italian and English. Newcomers can book a free trial lesson at any point in the year. The institute also organises residential seminars at Montauto, a farm estate in the Tuscan countryside near Rapolano Terme, including intensive weekends that prepare teachers for the Level 2 and 3 assessments and summer weeks with visiting senior teachers. A small library of full-length recorded classes by its teachers is free to follow on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Weekly Iyengar Yoga classes
courses.description: The institute's weekly timetable of studio, streamed and online classes at several levels, including an advanced group, classes for older students and a pranayama session. Fees and enrolment go through the office or the individual teacher.

courses.title: Seminari insegnanti livello 2/3 a Montauto
courses.description: Two residential weekends for certified teachers with Gabriella Giubilaro at the Montauto farm estate near Rapolano Terme. The work completes the postures of the teacher's current level and starts preparation for its assessment, with close attention to observing and adjusting students.

courses.title: Gabriella Giubilaro e Rosana Seligman
courses.description: A six-day summer intensive in the Tuscan countryside, taught jointly by the institute's founder and the Brazilian senior teacher Rosana Seligman. It is open to Iyengar teachers and experienced practitioners, with a morning and an afternoon class each day in a converted farm building.

free_resources.title: Lezioni di prova gratuite
free_resources.description: Free trial classes offered throughout the year with any of the institute's regular teachers. Booking is required through the office by email or phone.
